items.requirement: Role: complete PIXVA as a production TV diagnosis/repair/knowledge/booking/tracking/warranty platform (RTL Persian)
Master Prompt is the only source of truth; autonomous execution, no confirmation questions
Product scope: diagnosis, knowledge, booking, tracking, warranty, account, dashboard
Baseline: do not assume earlier work exists; preserve correct, repair incorrect, rebuild missing
Route map (31 routes), no duplicate indexable pages, no redirect chains
Diagnosis wizard UX: mobile, accessible, keyboard, loading/empty/error states
Diagnosis logic: brand→model→problem→symptoms→extra→likely/possible/needs-inspection→estimate only with data→booking
Price calculator: configurable pricing only; unset ⇒ inspection required, booking still possible
Error codes: full field set, search/filter, internal links, no unsafe electrical advice
Pixel test: solid colours, gradients, fullscreen, accessible, reduced motion, minimal JS
Booking: labels, server validation, nonce, rate limit, private image upload, duplicate protection, real states
Tracking: secure ID, no PII/internal notes, ownership proof
Warranty: configurable policy, never invent duration
Account: repairs/warranty/profile with authn/authz, no cross-user access
Dashboard: separate customer/technician/editor/admin, real data only
Content types for services, brands, models, problems, error codes, repairs, parts, articles, portfolio, FAQs, warranties, claims
Only expose types with legitimate content; private types for PII
Search across content types
Title/description/canonical/robots/OG
Honest schema; no LocalBusiness/reviews without real data
Paginated sitemap of canonical indexable URLs only
robots.txt must not block CSS/JS
Redirect manager (source, destination, status, date, notes, active) with chain/loop prevention
Useful 404 and 410 for gone content
Design tokens (12 colours), Vazirmatn, 8pt spacing; obsolete palette removed
3D only if it adds real value
items.blocker: No 3D: the v1.5 decorative 3D hero added weight without diagnostic value, so it was removed; no feature requires 3D.

items.requirement: Accessibility (WCAG): labels, focus, aria, contrast, error summaries
items.blocker: Automated checks (axe-core, Lighthouse, keyboard, live regions) pass on real staging; passes with real assistive technology (NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver) need Windows/macOS, which are not available.
